column1: # p348 — ACTION ZZ-y's channel, and the defect its FIRST BUILD shipped in this same pass.
# ZZ-y: "add the copyright-holder line to the placement channels, ranked above author addresses."
# The motivation was p347's read of `ls1intum/Ares2`, whose LICENSE names TUM in public, aggregate
# text and therefore survives the PII refusal that took author e-mail domains away from p346.
# Build 1 took every line CONTAINING the word `copyright`.  In an MIT payload that is three lines,
# and two of them are boilerplate present in every MIT grant on GitHub:
#   Copyright (c) 2011-2015 Twitter, Inc                                      ← the holder
#   The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included…  ← boilerplate
#   …AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER…  ← boilerplate
# so the token set of EVERY MIT payload contained {notice, permission, shall, holders, liable,
# claim, damages} and any two MIT files "agreed" on their holder.  Measured consequence, from this
# pass's own first run: Twitter's vendored Bootstrap grant inside
# `AcademicsToday/academicstoday-django` was graded OWN — the repository's own licence — which is
# precisely the ACTION ZZ-u over-grant the instrument was built to prevent.
# Build 2 adds two conditions.  The line must BEGIN with `Copyright` (after an optional comment
# marker), which drops both boilerplate sentences; and it must carry a FOUR-DIGIT YEAR, which drops
# Apache-2.0's appendix template `Copyright [yyyy] [name of copyright owner]` — a FORM, not a holder.
# 🔵 The transferable part is not the regex.  A channel that reads licence PROSE measures the
# licence, never the subject — the same error as reading a README badge as a grant (P342) and as
# reading a manifest's declaration as a payload.  This is that error's third surface, and the first
# where the KB wrote the detector itself.
payload
MIT, holder `Twitter, Inc` (vendored Bootstrap in AcademicsToday/academicstoday-django)
column2: Twitter, Inc + "notice and this permission notice shall be included in" + "HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER"
column4: OWN — WRONG, and it is the over-grant direction

column1: Apache-2.0 root text (appendix template only)
column2: [yyyy] [name of copyright owner] → rejected by the bracket rule
column5: HOLDER-ABSENT — and at the ROOT that is still the repository's grant, because position carries it

column1: MIT with a BOM, holder `Saigon University` (ACTION ZZ-w)
column5: OWN — the BOM strip holds on both the family and the holder channel

column1: MIT, five holder lines (the ls1intum/Ares2 shape)
column5: all three kept; `institution_of` fires on the two naming a university
